contract_traces.role: Actual GPU geometry construction, packing and readback receiver
contract_traces.trace: StripSource owns body field and longest strand metre length, separate from strand/card level and count. cards/ribbons build a shared native strip representation with source_rows/pieces/strips; build derives one common rows count and vertex byte length for four buffer streams and dispatches native kernel with all buffers/counts. Exact WGSL write_point stores positionxyz/occlusionw, normalxyz/randomw, tangentxyz/pad andUVxy/pad at one index; out_index derives same strip/row/edge slot. GpuGeometry.read reads native padded vec4 arrays and truncates each to common vertices count, then explicitly splits those roles into HairGeometry channels. faces builds two triangles for each consecutive pair of rows using same ordered strip topology. This is a source-backed native geometry byte/slot adapter; no blanket primitive exemption or shader/collision/driver validity guarantee, index-overflow/finite proof or universal arbitrary-buffer admission follows.

contract_traces.role: Carrying the same hair through distinct geometric transforms
contract_traces.trace: carried maps model positions through from.bust_point then to.point; normals through inverse normal map then normal; tangent directions through inverse direction then direction. UVs, occlusion, randoms and faces clone unchanged because the same hair topology/texture identity is retained while head frame changes. Actual HeadPlacement point includes origin translation, normal uses inverse-transpose under nonuniform scale and direction uses ordinary affine axes with normalization. This concrete distinction prevents treating normal and tangent transforms interchangeably under nonuniform head stretching; named field alone does not enforce the distinction on arbitrary public input vectors. No new universal frame/type system proposed and no degenerate-placement correctness claim.

contract_traces.role: Native atlas owner, authored packing and exact mip adapter
contract_traces.trace: GpuLods retains canonical CardAtlas shared byArc; native producer caches it under variants plus per-variant width/height and invokes CardAtlas::paint. paint sets total atlas width=per-variantwidth*variants, copies bundle columns into rows, and stores RGBA8 coverage,shade,depth,coverage. Exact output assignments320-329 verify channel meanings. Mips halve both dimensions with floor/max1 over actual levels, using per-channel2x2 byte averaging while dimensions remain>1 and levelcount<12. geometry.atlas_levels follows stored totalwidth/height and same halve/max1 rule, converting each complete four-byte texel to shadeRGB pluscoveragealpha. It does not reinterpret colour as another unit interval or require new per-byte wrappers at the image-format boundary. Native generated arrays have explicit dimension/count layout; public atlas mutation, invalid dimensions/overflow, procedural painting quality, full mip completeness and partial trailing-byte admission are not universally certified. as_chunks4 ignores a malformed partial final texel; actual native generated size is width*height*4, no ordinary malformed current producer witness claimed.
